question: What are the top three most frequently associated labels with artworks from each historical period in The Met's collection, only considering labels linked to 500 or more artworks? Provide me with the period, label, and the associated count.
sql:
WITH label_art_counts AS (
  SELECT la.description as label_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT o.object_id) as art_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.the_met.objects` o
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.the_met.vision_api_data` v ON o.object_id = v.object_id
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(v.labelAnnotations) AS la
  WHERE o.period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY la.description
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.object_id) >= 500
),
period_label_counts AS (
  SELECT o.period, la.description as label_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT o.object_id) as label_art_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.the_met.objects` o
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.the_met.vision_api_data` v ON o.object_id = v.object_id
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(v.labelAnnotations) AS la
  WHERE o.period IS NOT NULL
    AND la.description IN (SELECT label_desc FROM label_art_counts)
  GROUP BY o.period, la.description
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT period, label_desc, label_art_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY label_art_count DESC) as rn
  FROM period_label_counts
)
SELECT period, label_desc, label_art_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY period, rn
